title: Throwback to Thursday's Push Day question! 💪 #shorts #throwback #question #pushday
description: Throwback Thursday debate! Back in the day, I'd jump straight onto the dip bars without a second thought. But as a Vintage Athlete, my approach has shifted toward precision and longevity. Today, it's a toss-up between the deep mechanical burn of the tricep press and the functional power of the dip. One allows for surgical isolation, while the other demands total upper-body stability. I'm leaning toward the press for that controlled tempo today—but what about you? A or B? Let's hear your pick below! 💪🏋️‍♂️ #Throwback #Thursday #Athlete #Precision #Longevity #Tricep #Press #Dip #Power #Stability
